title: Optimal Estimators for Heavy-Tailed Mean Estimation via Convex Analysis
summary: We study optimal estimation of the location parameter of a distribution known only to lie in a symmetric moment class $\mathcal C_0$: the mean-zero distributions with bounded moment $\intφ\, d\mathbb P\le B$ for a fixed even $φ$. Our main result concerns the fixed-margin regime, where the error margin $Δ$ is fixed as $n\to\infty$: we give an exact large-deviation characterization of the smallest worst-case probability $β_n(Δ)$ of an error exceeding $Δ$ that any measurable estimator can guarantee with $n$ observations.
